About solar panels in Kenya

We sell 10 EcoFlow and BLUETTI solar panels from 45 W to 400 W, priced from KES 7,599 to KES 71,240. They recharge a power station from free sunshine, so you depend less on KPLC power and stay charged through long outages.

Read moreShow less

Foldable portable panels such as the EcoFlow Solar Panel 45W pack into a case and suit balconies, rooftops and trips. Rigid panels like the EcoFlow Rigid Solar Panel 125W x2 stay mounted permanently on a roof or frame. Flexible panels such as the EcoFlow Flexible Solar Panel 100W bend to fit vehicle roofs and curved surfaces.

Match panel watts to the power station. A station accepts solar up to its rated solar input; panels beyond that limit add no extra speed. For example, the BLUETTI AC200PL accepts 1200W Max (dual MPPT). A small panel such as the EcoFlow Solar Panel 45W keeps a compact station topped up, while the EcoFlow Portable Solar Panel 400W or several panels together recharge larger stations faster.

Kenya sits on the equator, so most regions get strong sun for much of the year, which makes solar a practical way to keep a power station charged between KPLC outages. Output still drops on cloudy days and during the long rains, so many homes size their panels with some headroom.

Our product data lists these connectors: EcoFlow MC4, XT60, MC4. Browse our power stations to pair a panel, and ask us on WhatsApp to confirm the right cable. Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.

Frequently asked questions

Which solar panel do I need for my power station?

Check the power station's solar input (listed in its specifications) and choose panels whose combined watts stay within it. The BLUETTI AC200PL, for example, accepts 1200W Max (dual MPPT). Bigger panels within that limit recharge faster. Message us the model on WhatsApp and we will confirm the panel and cable.

Foldable, rigid or flexible: which is best?

Foldable panels are portable and pack away, so they suit homes that move them in and out or take them travelling. Rigid panels are for permanent roof or frame mounting. Flexible panels are light and bend to fit vehicle roofs. All of them charge a compatible power station the same way.

How much does a solar panel produce in Kenya?

A panel's rating is its output in full sun: a 400 W panel gives up to 400 W. Real output is lower in cloud, heat and shade and changes through the day, so plan with some margin and angle the panel towards the midday sun.

Can I use BLUETTI panels with EcoFlow power stations?

It can work when the panel output fits the station's solar input and you use the right connector cable, but always check first. Send us both model names on WhatsApp and we will confirm whether they are compatible and which cable you need.

Do solar panels come with a warranty?

Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty. Pay by M-Pesa, card or cash on delivery, with same-day delivery in Nairobi and delivery to all 47 counties with an eTIMS invoice.
